verdict.rationale: Shopify classifies UCP agent traffic into three trust tiers: Token, Signed (RFC 9421 HTTP Message Signatures with ECDSA P-256, verified against the agent's published well-known UCP profile), and Anonymous. Each tier gets different rate limits and tool access, and every catalog request requires a hosted agent profile URL. A runtime probe confirmed that a request with no profile is rejected with invalid_profile_url. Missing for 10: evidence of merchant-facing visibility or reporting that shows which tier or identity an agent's traffic came from (enforcement is Shopify-side), and independent hands-on verification of the Signed and Token tiers.
